Your buddy asked you to fill in for him today, so you are here with friends, ready to work. You were excited for the opportunity to see the inside of the house--and the pay is good--but now that you are here, looking at the house, you wonder if you made the right decision.\n\nYou walk up the long road, slowly passing the front of the now-dilapidated mansion. The yards are dry and withered, cobblestones are upended, broken, and half-buried, and dead trees are strewn across the property. You cannot see through the windows for all the mud and spider webs. Looking around the yard, you remember something you were told about three kids found dead here 10 years ago. \n\nAfter the murders, old Mr Smith was never seen again. Folks had laughed off rumors that the kids never really left, but no buyer was found. Now they want to try to sell it again. You are here to get the house ready. And the estate looks like it has not been tended to since Mr Smith disappeared. \n\nAs you round the corner of the house, you come to a driveway and what looks like a gate at the end."
